purpose: Requested factor inventory, not a claim that each factor has predictive value. Exact implemented definitions are in features_v1.csv; unimplemented definitions and parameters must be preregistered before use.
actual_implemented_scope: Nine numeric features in three nested sets, observed trend/volatility/shock labels, fixed probabilistic baseline, an entry-veto bridge and official-feed availability parsing. Existing corrected ATR risk policy reused unchanged.

governance: All nonimplemented features remain NOT_TESTED or PENDING_DATA. No extra feature is activated by appearing in this catalogue. Every new combination needs a frozen experiment; no arbitrary agent voting or risk overrides.
